what_this_is: The deterministic backfill map from a capsule adapter, or an evidence kind, to the frozen provision it may cite in the optional capsule 0.3 provisions binding. Read by functions/api/_provisions.ts for the ?provision= door and checked by scripts/mechanism/capsule-provision-map.test.ts.
what_this_is_not: Not a re-emission of any capsule: no published capsule, batch or root changes. Not a statement that any measured party complies with any provision.
rule: An adapter or evidence kind maps to a provision only when an implemented predicate in scripts/mechanism/coverage.source.json names that provision and the producing code is that predicate's code. Every published v0.2 capsule adapter is listed, mapped or unmapped, so a new adapter fails the check until it is classified. Obligation aliases are derived from the Article numbers in each obligation's title in functions/api/_obligations.ts; an obligation whose title names no Article maps to no provision.

mappings.scope: Article 50(2) only: whether a generated file carries a machine-readable mark that named methods detect, at the time of the check.
mappings.capsule_state: NOT_EMITTED_AS_CAPSULE: the route returns signed packs and previews, not v0.2 capsule batches, so no published capsule carries this binding yet.

unmapped_adapters.reason: No implemented deterministic predicate names a frozen provision for this measurement, so no provision is mapped. A crosswalk or axis pointer is not a mapping.
